glomeris emergency — Degraded-path recovery with no network and no LLM.

usage: glomeris emergency

Can delete data — every deletion is policy-gated.

For when the disk is full enough that the normal path cannot run. Takes no
arguments, contacts no network, and uses no LLM — the recovery it performs
is the same policy-gated set of no-confirmation-needed actions, chosen without
any of the machinery that could itself need space. Holds the execution lock
for the whole run, so it exits 75 if another invocation already holds it.

Examples
  glomeris emergency
      The disk is full and nothing else will run.

See also: free, status
